note: Paired seeded corpus across languages. Each case carries its own `language`. Vulnerable variants -> potentially_exploitable; fixed -> likely_not_exploitable. Truth is for scoring only. The `-fixed` variants are `neutralized`, not `unreachable` and not plain `reachable`: untrusted input does arrive at the sink, and a named control on the path stops it. `unreachable` is reserved for the one case where no untrusted value reaches the sink at all. The distinction decides whether the probe runs, so it is ground truth rather than wording.
